name: security-marketplace-settlement-review
intent: Marketplace seller/customer settlement and fee allocation integrity
artifacts: Seller/order mapping, connected-account selection, fee/refund rules and provider sandbox settlement.
trace: Follow client-selected seller/account IDs to payout recipient and reconcile gross, fees, refunds and net settlement.
experiment: Use two owned sandbox sellers and a synthetic order; compare correct settlement with one foreign seller/account substitution.
disproof: Public seller metadata is not settlement authority; a rejected provider account mismatch closes the proposed transfer path.
repair: Bind financial recipients to server order ownership and verify correct allocation and refund reversal.
branch_decisions: Track the server order seller, connected payment account and fee/refund allocation independently. A seller display ID may be public while settlement account selection is protected. Report the exact value or recipient mismatch established by provider sandbox and internal ledger, not a hypothetical full-platform theft chain.
operational_method: For one owned order, reconcile gross captured amount with seller allocation, platform fee, tax/other contract allocations and linked refunds/chargebacks. Identify the actor allowed to change each destination or allocation and compare it with the provider sandbox settlement account actually selected. A visible seller identifier mismatch alone is not diverted funds; retain both provider and internal posting IDs and do not assume one fee convention for every marketplace.
